rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something relating to an economy.

example.english: This policy has a big economic impact.
example.traditional: 呢個政策對經濟方面嘅影響幾大。

rows.note: Use this specifically for matters relating to economics as an academic or analytical subject.

example.english: This course mainly covers economic theory.
example.traditional: 呢科主要講經濟學方面嘅理論。
